description: Renovate is the single owner of dependency updates for this repo; keep repository-level (UI) Dependabot disabled.

Covers: Go modules (cli/), Helm chart dependencies (helm-charts/*/Chart.yaml), GitHub Actions pins, and chart revision pins in tenants/*/tenant.yaml and tools/gateway-api-crd-pin.yaml via the custom regex managers below.
Tenant service entries with chart: "" (git-sourced or vendored via chartPath) are intentionally not matched — only registry-backed chart pins are updated.

packageRules.description: The Gateway API pin gets a pull request of its own. Its freshness check stays red until someone regenerates the vendored bundle and pushes that commit to the branch, and Renovate stops rebasing any branch that carries a commit it did not write. Inside the weekly batch, that froze every other update behind it.

Storage and database layer: each of these gets its own pull request, outside the weekly batch. Merging here is deploying, and an upgrade to Longhorn, the TrueNAS CSI driver or the Postgres operator and its clusters is done by a person in a chosen window, one at a time. Batched with a dozen routine bumps, the routine ones cannot merge until the storage window comes.

customManagers.description: Chart pins in tenant manifests served from HTTPS Helm repositories (chart/repo/revision triples)
Chart pins in tenant manifests served from OCI registries (ghcr.io)

Gateway API CRD bundle vendored into bootstrap/crds/foundation-crds.yaml. Renovate raises the version; it cannot regenerate 17k lines of CRD from a hosted run, so its PR fails foundation-crds-freshness until someone runs 'python3 tools/sync-gateway-api-crds.py --write'. That red check is the handoff, not a bug — do not resolve it by reverting the bump. The channel is a deliberate choice and is never updated automatically.
